Criterion: High-polling HID behind an additional hub
Evidence: VENDOR_GUIDANCE + SPEC; observable: hub chain and HS endpoint; actual report rate requires separate evidence
Action: Test a native root socket; do not assume a general lag penalty. Test: T_PORT/T_RATE. Sources: RAZER_8K,MS_ENDPOINT.

Criterion: High-polling device on EHCI or a legacy host
Evidence: REVIEWER_MEASURED_FOR_TEST_SETUP; observable: host model/endpoint; EHCI alone does not establish the rate
Action: Do not claim EHCI can never support 8 kHz. Test: T_RATE. Sources: TPU_RAZER,MS_ENDPOINT.

Criterion: Two HID devices at 2 kHz or above on the same external hub
Evidence: VENDOR_GUIDANCE + MECHANISTIC_PLAUSIBLE; observable: an actual shared hub upstream
Action: Compare separate root ports. Test: T_LOAD/T_PORT. Sources: RAZER_8K,MS_BW.

Criterion: Two HID devices at 2 kHz or above on different root ports of one xHCI
Evidence: SPEC; observable: two distinct root-port paths
Action: Do not penalize devices just for sharing xHCI. Test: T_LOAD. Sources: MS_ENDPOINT.

Criterion: HID shares a USB 2 hub upstream with active isochronous audio/video
Evidence: SPEC + PLAUSIBLE; observable: active isochronous endpoint and bandwidth domain required
Action: Confirm the load first, then test a separate hub. Test: T_LOAD. Sources: MS_BW,ELG_TRANS.

Criterion: Full-Speed HID and active Full-Speed isochronous traffic share a confirmed Single-TT hub
Evidence: SPEC + PLAUSIBLE; observable: USB_HUB_CAP_FLAGS.HubIsMultiTtCapable/HubIsMultiTt through hub IOCTLs, where queryable
Action: With actual load and symptoms, compare another hub or Multi-TT hub without assuming a conflict. Test: T_LOAD. Sources: MS_BW.

Criterion: Two High-Speed cameras share an actual periodic bandwidth budget
Evidence: OS_DOC + SPEC; observable: active isochronous transfers and shared resource context required
Action: If failures or dropped frames occur, compare a separate hub/controller. Test: T_VIDEO. Sources: MS_BW,ELG_TRANS.

Criterion: A 2.4 GHz dongle is physically close to an active SuperSpeed emitter
Evidence: MEASURED_VENDOR + VENDOR_GUIDANCE; observable: physical proximity requires a manually confirmed port map
Action: Test separation distance or a USB 2 extension and compare radio stability. Test: T_RF. Sources: INTEL_RF.

Criterion: Dongle connected to a USB 3 dock or SuperSpeed hub
Evidence: VENDOR_GUIDANCE; observable: topology known, RF coupling unknown
Action: For radio problems, use an RF A/B test instead of prohibiting USB 3 generally. Test: T_RF. Sources: INTEL_RF.

Criterion: Multiple wireless dongles directly next to each other
Evidence: VENDOR_GUIDANCE; observable: physical proximity confirmed
Action: Separate receivers for a comparison; a conflict is not inevitable. Test: T_RF. Sources: INTEL_RF.

Criterion: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi or many BSS networks near a gaming dongle
Evidence: SPEC + VENDOR_GUIDANCE; observable: Wi-Fi frequency may require permission
Action: Compare 5 GHz Wi-Fi only for observed radio errors. Test: T_RF. Sources: INTEL_RF.

Criterion: Bluetooth input device instead of a wired or 2.4 GHz connection
Evidence: DEVICE-SPECIFIC_MEASUREMENT; observable: connection type known; effect is device-specific
Action: Do not transfer mouse-review latency figures to gamepads. Historical V4/Gamepadla reports lower mean Bluetooth latency for Sony pads than stock wired mode (DualSense 6.0–9.0 vs. 7.8–11.3 ms), but more jitter and outliers up to 28 ms; Xbox/Flydigi/GameSir favor wired or dongle modes. Assess the specific model and jitter. These historical references remain unverified here. Test: T_RATE. Sources: REG_CHI.

Criterion: Advertised 8 kHz HID actually uses ordinary Full-Speed interrupt transfers
Evidence: SPEC + OS_DOC; observable: link speed and associated endpoint
Action: Check the High-Speed path and firmware mode. Test: T_RATE. Sources: MS_ENDPOINT,WOOT_8K.

Criterion: HID on an additional PCIe USB controller
Evidence: VENDOR_GUIDANCE; observable: PCI ID checked against a verified list
Action: Do not assume a general latency penalty for xHCI add-in boards. Test: T_PORT. Sources: MS_USBVIEW.

Criterion: HID on chipset xHCI rather than CPU xHCI
Evidence: NO EVIDENCE in either direction; the igor'sLAB reference was withdrawn in V4, section 8.1; observable: controller/board mapping
Action: No CPU-port bonus and no claim of measured equality; topology information only. Test: T_PORT. Sources: none.

Criterion: A 1 kHz HID alone behind a functioning hub
Evidence: SPEC + MEASURED; Wimmer et al., CHI 2019 section 6.3: no measurable addition from USB 2.0/3.0 hubs in the tested Linux-host keypress setup at up to 1 kHz, 5,000 measurements per condition; observable: hub/link known
Action: No automatic lag penalty. Test: T_PORT. Sources: MS_ENDPOINT,REG_CHI.

Criterion: A 1 kHz mouse and keyboard share a root controller
Evidence: NO_EVIDENCE_OF_GENERAL_CONFLICT; observable: controller membership
Action: No intervention based on shared controller membership alone. Test: T_LOAD. Sources: MS_BW.

Criterion: Input device behind a Thunderbolt or USB4 dock
Evidence: OS_DOC; E2E_UNKNOWN; observable: actual hub/PCIe controller chain where available
Action: Compare a direct connection only for reproducible errors. The regular USB 2 path at USB4/TB4 uses D+/D− and USB 2 hubs; some Thunderbolt docks also expose PCIe-tunneled xHCI controllers. Do not infer behavior from the dock brand alone. Test: T_PORT. Sources: MS_USB4.

Criterion: Selective Suspend enabled in the plan and device actually eligible
Evidence: OS_DOC + VENDOR_GUIDANCE; observable: eligibility and idle state also required
Action: Use a reversible comparison only for resume problems. Test: T_WAKE. Sources: MS_HIDSEL.

Criterion: Selective Suspend enabled in the plan while the inbox HID driver opted out
Evidence: OS_DOC; observable: device/driver state
Action: Do not claim an effect. Test: T_WAKE. Sources: MS_HIDSEL.

Criterion: Hub supports idle power-down and resume errors are documented
Evidence: OS_DOC + VENDOR_GUIDANCE; observable: an active problem condition required
Action: Compare hub power states manually. Test: T_WAKE/T_ETW. Sources: MS_ETW.

Criterion: ASPM enabled with USB controller behind PCIe
Evidence: MECHANISTIC_PLAUSIBLE; observable: power plan/controller path
Action: No blanket recommendation to disable ASPM. Test: T_WAKE. Sources: MS_USB4.

Criterion: Core parking allowed by the power plan
Evidence: OS_DOC + MECHANISTIC_PLAUSIBLE; observable: plan indices are not actual core residency
Action: Do not change settings without a reproducible effect. Test: T_SOFT. Sources: MS_INPUTFIX.

Criterion: Minimum processor state below 100%
Evidence: OS_DOC; INPUT_EFFECT_UNKNOWN; observable: plan index readable
Action: No blanket 100% minimum processor state. Test: T_SOFT. Sources: MS_INPUTFIX.

Criterion: Energy Saver enabled during a latency measurement
Evidence: OS_DOC; observable: system state can be checked
Action: Document the measurement context and provide a relevant user note if needed. Test: T_SOFT. Sources: MS_INPUTFIX.

Criterion: Laptop on battery with a changing power plan
Evidence: OS_DOC; observable: actually read AC/DC state and plan
Action: Compare AC/DC while controlling temperature. Test: T_SOFT. Sources: MS_INPUTFIX.

Criterion: High-power audio interface on a bus-powered hub
Evidence: VENDOR_GUIDANCE + POWER_REQUIREMENT; observable: hub power/device model; available budget uncertain
Action: Compare a direct, adequately powered port. Test: T_POWER. Sources: FOC_POWER,MS_HUB.

Criterion: SuperSpeed capture and another sustained SuperSpeed load share a hub
Evidence: SPEC + VENDOR_GUIDANCE; observable: shared SS upstream and actual load
Action: Compare a separate SS upstream. Test: T_VIDEO. Sources: ELG_FREEZE.

Criterion: 8 kHz High-Speed HID on a USB 2 socket under xHCI
Evidence: SPEC + OS_DOC; observable: High-Speed and bInterval=1 verified
Action: Do not automatically prefer a USB 3 socket. Test: T_RATE. Sources: MS_ENDPOINT.

Criterion: Reconnecting changes LocationPath
Evidence: OS_DOC; observable: PnP change and parent mapping
Action: Repeat the before/after measurement. Test: T_PORT. Sources: MS_DEVCHANGE.

Criterion: High-polling device or 2.4 GHz dongle on a front panel
Evidence: MECHANISTIC_PLAUSIBLE + VENDOR; observable: front-panel location confirmed by user/board documentation
Action: Do not always move it to the rear; assess RF and hub tradeoffs separately. Test: T_PORT/T_RF. Sources: INTEL_RF.

Criterion: High-polling device or dongle on a monitor hub with other devices
Evidence: SPEC + VENDOR; observable: shared upstream and active traffic; RF is separate
Action: Evaluate polling and radio as separate cases. Test: T_LOAD/T_RF. Sources: MS_BW,INTEL_RF.

Criterion: KVM emulation established with reduced polling or re-enumeration
Evidence: DEVICE-SPECIFIC_OBSERVATION; observable: emulation mode and a specific error
Action: Consider true USB passthrough or a direct connection. Test: T_RATE/T_BOOT. Sources: MS_ENDPOINT.

Criterion: DDM/passthrough KVM without a measured conflict
Evidence: VENDOR_GUIDANCE; observable: manufacturer profile and current USB path
Action: Switching time is not ongoing report latency. Test: T_PORT. Sources: MS_USBVIEW.

Criterion: USB4 or Thunderbolt dock used during gaming
Evidence: OS_DOC; E2E_UNKNOWN; observable: dock topology partially available
Action: Treat direct connection as an A/B test, not a universal requirement. Test: T_PORT. Sources: MS_USB4.

Criterion: RGB/fan controller on an internal header
Evidence: MECHANISTIC_PLAUSIBLE; observable: USB device/interface
Action: No general controller penalty. Test: T_SOFT. Sources: MS_USBVIEW.

Criterion: xHCI uses an active INTx resource instead of MSI
Evidence: OS_DOC; GAIN_UNKNOWN; observable: assigned CM interrupt resource
Action: No automatic MSI registry change. Test: T_ETW. Sources: MS_ETW.

Criterion: 8 kHz device with IMODI greater than zero
Evidence: SPEC; PERFORMANCE_UNKNOWN; observable: IMOD is UNKNOWN without privileged reads
Action: Do not set it to zero; research only. Test: T_RATE. Sources: MS_ENDPOINT.

Criterion: Multiple devices at 4 kHz or above suspected to share an interrupter
Evidence: MECHANISTIC_PLAUSIBLE; observable: mapping is not known from PnP
Action: No interrupter-coupling score. Test: T_LOAD. Sources: MS_ENDPOINT.

Criterion: Front panel with a connected SuperSpeed device
Evidence: MECHANISTIC_PLAUSIBLE; observable: neither RF proximity nor shielding quality is known automatically
Action: Provide an RF note only with an additional dongle/error condition. Test: T_RF. Sources: INTEL_RF.

Criterion: KVM with unknown true passthrough behavior
Evidence: UNKNOWN; observable: manufacturer/device identity may be insufficient
Action: Missing evidence is not proof of a polling limit. Test: T_BOOT/T_RATE. Sources: MS_USBVIEW.

Criterion: Dock with Selective Suspend enabled in the power plan
Evidence: OS_DOC; observable: the plan alone does not establish actual suspension
Action: Check device/hub state and resume first. Test: T_WAKE. Sources: MS_HIDSEL.

Criterion: Raw Input background listener or queue coalescing biases timing
Evidence: OS_DOC + MEASUREMENT_BIAS; observable: foreground/listener/process state can be captured
Action: Assess measurement quality instead of USB hardware. Test: T_SOFT. Sources: MS_INPUTFIX,MS_RAW.

Criterion: Unknown UVC webcam transfer mode is incorrectly counted as isochronous
Evidence: VENDOR_DOC_CONTRADICTION; observable: endpoint/active mode unclear
Action: Do not trigger an isochronous-bandwidth rule. Test: T_VIDEO. Sources: ELG_TRANS.

Criterion: SuperSpeed-capable device uses a slower link type
Evidence: OS_DOC; observable: EX_V2 capabilities and active link speed
Action: Check cable, port, adapter and mode; classify as PROBLEM only if the required function needs SuperSpeed. Test: T_VIDEO/T_POWER. Sources: MS_CONNV2.
